title: Aces
body:
In tennis, a player hits an ace when their serve is untouched by the opponent. Your friend Tim is interested in analyzing the $$8$$ male tennis professionals who have hit the most aces throughout tennis history. The table below is called $$	exttt{tennis}$$ and includes statistics obtained from the ATP Tour. The table is sorted in decreasing order of Num. Aces, the total number of aces (as an integer) hit by that player in their career.
Each bullet lists a player's name, nationality, number of aces, matches played, height in cm and weight in kg:

Unfortunately, the code Tim wrote to analyze the data has some issues. Below are some error messages that appeared, along with what Tim was trying to calculate. Describe the issues and explain how you would change the code to fix them.
